stem: A test plan needs 7,600 users per variant. The test reaches that number on day 10, a Wednesday. What should the team do?

options.text: Stop on day 10, since reaching the sample size is the only stop rule
Stop on day 10 and drop the weekend data, so the weekdays are balanced
Keep the test running to day 14, so that it covers two full weeks
Keep checking, and stop on the first day that p falls below 0.05
